description: Narrative & educational features — the remaining Phase 12 gaps: what-if/counterfactual overlays, new quiz question types, persistent + shareable quiz results, and research/academic tools (citations, stable entity URLs, versioning, DOIs). Excludes already-done curated journeys, autoplay, multiple-choice quiz, difficulty scaling, and shareable view-state URLs.

userStories.title: What-If scenario overlay system
userStories.description: As a learner, I want hypothetical scenario overlays so I can explore counterfactual history, clearly marked as speculative.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a scenario-overlay layer (e.g. 'What if the Bronze Age Collapse hadn't happened') rendered over the map with a distinct speculative styling and a persistent 'speculative/educational' banner
Scenarios are data-driven (a scenarios TSV/JSON) so new ones can be authored without code
Toggling a scenario adjusts affected layers without mutating the underlying dataset
vitest tests cover scenario loading + toggle; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Alternative-Urheimat migration toggle
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to switch between competing Urheimat hypotheses and see the migration map change so I can compare theories.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a toggle that selects among competing hypotheses in UrheimatHypothesisLayer.tsx and re-renders associated migration routes accordingly
The selected hypothesis drives which migration LineStrings/animations display; unselected ones dim
Clearly label each as a scholarly hypothesis with consensus level and sources
vitest tests cover hypothesis-driven route selection; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Counterfactual trade routes
userStories.description: As a learner, I want speculative trade-route overlays so I can explore 'what if' economic geography, marked speculative.
acceptanceCriteria: Add counterfactual trade-route overlays (e.g. 'Silk Road to the Americas') distinct from the real trade-routes layer and clearly marked speculative
Counterfactual routes are data-driven and never mixed into the real trade-routes dataset
Toggle on/off independently of real routes
vitest tests cover rendering + separation from real data; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Dish-origin quiz question type
userStories.description: As a learner, I want a 'where did this dish originate?' map-click question so cuisine data is quizzable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a cuisine/dish map-click question generator to server/services/quiz-generator.ts using cuisine originRegion/coordinates data
Scoring reuses the existing haversine scoreMapClick with difficulty tolerances
The question renders via the existing MapClickQuestion component
vitest tests extend test/test-quiz-generator.ts for dish questions; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Chronological civilization ordering quiz
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to place civilizations in chronological order so I can test temporal knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a drag-sort question generator that asks to order civilizations chronologically (by founding/peak year)
Reuse the existing DragSortQuestion component and scoring
Difficulty scales the number/closeness of items
vitest tests cover ordering correctness; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Persistent quiz progress & streaks
userStories.description: As a learner, I want my quiz history saved so I can track improvement over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist per-session results (score, category, difficulty, timestamp) to localStorage (and optionally an endpoint)
Show a progress view with history, streaks, and per-category mastery
Difficulty auto-scales based on recent performance (optional toggle)
vitest tests cover persistence + streak logic; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Shareable quiz results
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to share my quiz results so I can compare with others.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a shareable result (URL and/or image card) summarizing score and category
Reuse the existing shareable-state/URL utilities where possible
Shared links render a read-only result summary
vitest tests cover result encoding; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Citation export (BibTeX) for entities
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to export an entity's sources as BibTeX so I can cite the data in papers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a citation generator that emits BibTeX (and optionally RIS/CSL-JSON) from an entity's sources[] fields
Add a 'Cite' action to entity detail panels and a download endpoint
Handle entities with missing/partial sources gracefully
vitest tests validate BibTeX output for sample entities; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Stable, citable per-entity URLs
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a canonical URL for every entity so I can cite specific records.
acceptanceCriteria: Add stable routes for all major entity types (language, family, civilization, culture, site, deity, etc.), not just culture-profile reports
URLs are permanent identifiers; a resolver maps id -> canonical path; deep-link view state remains via existing useShareableState
Unknown/renamed ids resolve or 404 gracefully
vitest tests cover route resolution; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Data versioning & changelog
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a browsable changelog of data additions/edits so I can trust provenance over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a versioning service that records dataset changes (added/modified rows, source, timestamp) into a changelog
Expose a changelog view/endpoint filterable by domain and date
Integrate with the contribution pipeline so approved edits are logged
vitest tests cover changelog recording; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Versioned dataset releases with DOIs + public dataset API
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want citable, versioned dataset snapshots and a documented API so the corpus is academically usable.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend server/services/export-pipeline.ts to produce versioned snapshots (semver + changelog) and integrate DOI minting (e.g. Zenodo) for releases
Formalize a documented, versioned public dataset API (OpenAPI) with a full-dataset access/download endpoint
Snapshot metadata includes version, DOI, license, and row counts
vitest tests cover snapshot metadata + versioning; `npm run check` passes
